capabilities: Browse vault data in configurable node-based explorers
Filter and select files, tags, properties or content
Queue and apply batch file-edit operations
Toggle snippets and plugins from the sidebar
Arrange explorers as tree, table or card views
extras: Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README warns beta versions can break the vault and that the Operation sets section is under maintenance.
intentEvidence: aims to expand your Obsidian Core plugins, adding functionality and flexibility to the data and metadata explorers
problem: Obsidian's built-in explorers show data in fixed layouts and offer no way to filter, select and batch-edit vault data from one place.
